steps.title: locate vlabench entity · move vlabench ee to · close vlabench gripper
steps.code:
# Locate salad_dressing fresh evidence handle
res_locate_dressing = primitives.call(name='locate_vlabench_entity', entity_name='salad_dressing')
handle_dressing = res_locate_dressing.output['evidence_handle']
pos_dressing = res_locate_dressing.output['world_target']
print("salad_dressing:", pos_dressing, handle_dressing)

# First hover above the dressing bottle
hover_pos = [pos_dressing[0], pos_dressing[1], pos_dressing[2] + 0.15]
res_hover = primitives.call(
    name='move_vlabench_ee_to',
    evidence_handles=[handle_dressing],
    target_position=hover_pos,
    gripper_state=0.04,
    horizon=25
)
print("hover ok:", res_hover.ok)

# Move down to grasp height
grasp_pos = [pos_dressing[0], pos_dressing[1], pos_dressing[2] + 0.02]
res_down = primitives.call(
    name='move_vlabench_ee_to',
    evidence_handles=[handle_dressing],
    target_position=grasp_pos,
    gripper_state=0.04,
    horizon=25
)
print("down ok:", res_down.ok)

# Close gripper firmly
res_close = primitives.call(name='close_vlabench_gripper', horizon=25)
print("close ok:", res_close.ok)

# Lift end effector with handle
res_lift = primitives.call(
    name='lift_vlabench_ee',
    evidence_handles=[handle_dressing],
    lift_height=0.2
)
print("lift ok:", res_lift.ok)
